description: PyTorch works with tensors and neural-network layers. Learn shapes, simple calculations, gradients and training steps using small examples with honest limits. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.

Practise a linear layer learns weights
Practise build a small sequential model
